cbc.hemoglobin.source: NIH MedlinePlus / standard adult panic values

cbc.rbc.source: Illustrative severe-range values. Verify before use.

cbc.wbc.source: Illustrative severe-range values, rescaled to cells/µL. Verify before use.

cbc.platelets.source: Standard platelet panic values, rescaled to cells/µL.

cbc.hematocrit.source: Standard adult panic values (hematocrit <20% or >60%), as in common lab panic tables

cbc.mcv.source: Illustrative: no widely standardised MCV panic value. Verify before use.

lipid.total_cholesterol.source: Illustrative: severe-hypercholesterolemia threshold; no standard panic value. Verify before use.

lipid.ldl.source: NCEP ATP III 'very high' LDL threshold (>=190 mg/dL)

lipid.hdl.source: Illustrative: very low HDL threshold; no standard panic value. Verify before use.

lipid.triglycerides.source: NCEP ATP III severe-hypertriglyceridemia threshold (>=500 mg/dL), pancreatitis risk

hba1c.hba1c.source: Illustrative: severe-hyperglycemia HbA1c threshold; no standard panic value. Verify before use.

thyroid.tsh.source: µIU/mL is numerically equal to mIU/L. Illustrative. Verify before use.

thyroid.t3.source: Illustrative: no standard panic value for total T3. Verify before use.

thyroid.t4.source: TOTAL T4 in µg/dL, not free T4 in ng/dL. Illustrative. Verify before use.

lft.bilirubin_total.source: Illustrative: commonly cited severe-hyperbilirubinemia threshold. Verify before use.

lft.alt.source: Illustrative: transaminases above ~500 U/L are a recognised severe elevation. Verify before use.

lft.ast.source: Illustrative: transaminases above ~500 U/L are a recognised severe elevation. Verify before use.

lft.alp.source: Illustrative: no standard ALP panic value. Verify before use.

lft.albumin.source: Illustrative: commonly cited severe-hypoalbuminemia threshold. Verify before use.
